landing_heading: Track what you eat without the busywork
landing_subheading: Log meals by hand or from a photo, see your daily calories and macros at a glance, and ask an AI assistant about your diet.
feature_manual_description: Add a meal with its calories, protein, fat and carbs.
feature_picture_description: Take a picture of your food and let AI estimate the nutrition values.
feature_overview_description: See how many calories and macros you have eaten today.
feature_chat_description: Ask questions about your meals and get suggestions based on what you logged.
about_text: Built for the RTU course "Programmatūras izstrādes tehnoloģija" as a prototype of the app described in the previous assignments.
theme_toggle: Switch between light and dark theme
overview_goal_note: Goals are fixed for now: EU reference intakes for an average adult.
